title: War Orphans, Korea, 09/18/1953 - 09/20/1953
summary: National Archives description: "MS, tiny Korean child escorted by an older seven year old waif walking down street; military jeep in background drives up, stops, and two MPs emerge. MS, US and South Korean MP walk up to the children and make friends with them. Seq: MPs driving two Korean children to a collection center. MS, orphan arrives at entrance to administration tent and receive inoculation
